title: Pan-Seared Gyoza
description: Crunchy and savory Japanese dumplings filled with tofu, pan-seared to perfection.

ingredients.name: Gyoza wrappers
ingredients.notes: usually found in the Asian food section

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. In a pan, heat sesame oil and sauté ginger until fragrant.
3. Add crumbled tofu and cook until lightly browned.
4. Add soy sauce and quick-fry sauce (if using) and stir-fry until combined.
5. Lay a gyoza wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the tofu mixture in the center.
6. Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
7. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
8. Press the edges together to seal the gyoza and press the edges to seal.
9. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
10. Add 1-2 tablespoons of oil to the preheated skillet and swirl it around.
11. Place the gyoza in the skillet, seam-side down, and pan-fry until the bottom is golden brown.
12. Flip the gyoza over and cook until the other side is also golden brown.
